name: KV-cache Gate-2 verified per-task CSP solver
purpose: Fix Item112's failed generic CSP search harness by adding a verified per-task CSP solver with task-specific parse/render I/O gates and a Gate-2 oracle-CBJ search-correctness gate. mini_sudoku, n_queens, and futoshiki now all pass I/O verification and Gate-2 oracle-CBJ solve >=0.99 using official Reasoning Gym scoring. Verified couple arms were run as the first post-Gate-2 arm read; cost and C1 reason still need to be layered onto the verified solver before P1-A headline reads.

provenance.spec: user CODING SPEC Gate-2 Fix, Verified Per-Task CSP Solver for P1-A v0

code_added_used.change: Adds task-specific parsers/renderers, I/O gates, verified CBJ solver, Gate-2 oracle-CBJ search gate, and verified couple arms for mini_sudoku, n_queens, and futoshiki.

commands.command: python -m analysis.kvcache_gate2_csp_solver io-gate/gate2 for mini_sudoku, n_queens, futoshiki, n=20
commands.purpose: Verify parse/render I/O and oracle-CBJ Gate-2 search correctness.

commands.command: python -m analysis.kvcache_gate2_csp_solver arms --job couple for mini_sudoku, n_queens, futoshiki, R=2,4,8,16, n=20
commands.purpose: Run the first post-Gate-2 verified couple landscape.

headline.couple_read: verified couple arms complete; oracle solves all at high R, low-R futoshiki oracle shows bounded-window NO_RECOVERY_TARGET at R=2/4; random is lower across tasks.
headline.single_next_move: Layer cost token accounting and C1 reason prompts onto this verified solver before reading P1-A cost/reason. Do not use the old generic CSP harness.

decision.next_step_routing: Use analysis/kvcache_gate2_csp_solver.py as the P1-A base. Add verified cost and C1 reason hooks there, then relaunch P1-A cost/reason in priority order.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item fixes Gate-2 search correctness and runs a verified couple landscape. It does not establish P1-A C1 reason generalization or A-vs-C cost ratios yet, because those hooks still need to be layered onto the verified solver.
honesty.n_queens_io_note: n_queens uses zero-indexed columns internally, so column 0 is a valid given. The I/O gate was fixed to treat 0 as valid for n_queens while preserving nonzero checks for grid CSPs.
